definitions.gloss: spirit of adventure; adventurousness; sense of adventure
definitions.explanation: The desire or willingness to take on challenges, try new things, or explore the unknown. Often used positively to describe curiosity and boldness.

examples.japanese: {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}をくすぐられる。
examples.english: It tickles my sense of adventure.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は{冒険心|ぼうけんしん}にあふれていた。
examples.english: When I was a child, I was full of adventurous spirit.

examples.japanese: {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}が{旺盛|おうせい}な{彼|かれ}は、{一人|ひとり}でアマゾンの{奥地|おくち}まで{旅|たび}をした。
examples.english: Having a strong sense of adventure, he traveled alone deep into the Amazon.

notes:
USAGE:
{冒険心|ぼうけんしん} follows the common Japanese pattern of combining a noun with {心|しん} (heart/spirit) to express a feeling or disposition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}をくすぐる (to stimulate one's sense of adventure)
- {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}にあふれる (to be full of adventurous spirit)
- {冒険心|ぼうけんしん}が{旺盛|おうせい} (having a strong sense of adventure)

RELATED PATTERN:
Other 〜{心|しん} compounds: {好奇心|こうきしん} (curiosity), {探究心|たんきゅうしん} (spirit of inquiry), {向上心|こうじょうしん} (desire for self-improvement).
